notes: Refinement: height alone is explicitly insufficient; common tower identity now includes slender footprint, inter-building spacing and communal pools/gardens/open ground.

Reuse: the standard residential tower remains inside the shared coastal tower archetype, but Benidorm’s site grammar is a strong city variant; hotel, podium and new-compound families remain separate city-specific profiles rather than being flattened into one tower type.

Heritage disagreement: Torre Morales is added separately from Torre de les Caletes and preserves conflicting municipal dating rather than selecting one chronology.
POI coverage: Levante, Poniente, Mal Pas, Paseo de Poniente and Serra Gelada are added because they materially structure identity/game space rather than to inflate POI count.
